# NG On Device Expense Tracker

> Privacy-first on-device AI expense tracker and receipt extractor built with Angular and WebAssembly.

## Overview

NG On Device Expense Tracker allows users to track expenses, extract receipt details completely locally on device without sending sensitive financial data to external servers, and visualize spending patterns.

## Pages & Features

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Main overview of expenses and spending analytics.
- [Extract Expense](/extract): On-device receipt and invoice scanner.
- [Expense History](/history): Comprehensive transaction history and insights.
- [Settings](/settings): Configuration, backup, and AI model controls.
